title: managed SOC Alert: Nina Ruiz Account Compromised

fields.subject: Critical Account Compromise: User nruiz@lislevotes.example
fields.note: This alert was generated by CISA’s automated threat intelligence feed. The user account 'nruiz@lislevotes.example' (Nina Ruiz, VR Clerk) has been confirmed compromised via a phishing campaign. A forwarding rule was detected and removed. All access to VoterTrack has been blocked. Preserve logs and initiate incident response per CISA guidance.

original.subject: Critical Account Compromise: User nruiz@lislevotes.example
original.body:
Alert: Forwarding rule detected on user 'nruiz@lislevotes.example' (Nina Ruiz, VR Clerk). Rule forwards all incoming emails to 'nruiz.archive@mailbox-relay.example' (external domain). Rule was created 02:03 and active until 08:20. 120 API calls to VoterTrack database logged between 02:05 and 02:40. Source IP: 10.100.45.12 (unauthorized). No MFA prompt recorded.

Action: Account disabled. Forwarding rule removed. Logs preserved. All data access to VoterTrack now blocked for this account.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the compromise of Nina Ruiz's account and triggers the formal forensic preservation step. The IT team must now halt any manual account recovery and follow the CISA guidance in C2. Watch for any attempt to re-enable the account or bypass the block.

citations.quote: 1. Disable the account in Entra ID and revoke sessions (County CISO); reset its second factor. 2. Look for mailbox rules (forwarding, deletion) and messages sent from the account in the past 30 days;
